title: Cone criterion: ∂C = 0 and x ∧ C⃗ = 0 imply η_{0,λ#}C = C (Simon Lemma 6.2.33)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, n ≥ 1, C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) and R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep(ℝ^P, n) with C = τ(M, θ, ξ) (R.Represents C). Assume ∂C = 0 (BoundaryVanishes C). Assume also x ∧ C⃗ = 0 μ_C-a.e., in the sense that for R.measure-a.e. x, ξ(x)(β.curryLeft x) = 0 for every (n+1)-covector β. Then C is a cone: currentEval(η_{0,λ#}C, ω) = C(ω) for every λ > 0 and every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (IsConeCurrent C).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), 0 < n → R.Represents C → BoundaryVanishes C → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) (n + 1), R.orient x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.curryLeft β x) = 0) → IsConeCurrent C
